card.name: First names in author lists
card.fires_on: A person's first name (or its first piece) in a list of authors or investigators, right after a comma or title and before the surname. Seen in citation lists and trial investigator lists.

modes.label: Author lists in citations
modes.description: First name of a co-author in a reference list of scientific papers.
modes.example: Richard D. Schaller, Melissa A. Petruska, and<< Victor>> I. Klimov; Appl.

modes.label: Investigator or named researchers
modes.description: First name of an investigator or researcher before the surname, in trial rosters or news text.

card.writes: Suggests the next piece is a surname, favoring name endings and surname fragments.
card.plain: It marks a first name in a list of authors, where a surname comes next.
